headline: Afico Calls for Fiscal Harmonization for Crowdfunding; Warns of Disincentives to Credit
summary: Afico president Gerardo Obregón said crowdfunding institutions are regulated as financial entities but do not receive the same tax treatment. He warned this distortion discourages lending.
why: Crowdfunding platforms connect small investors with borrowers, and tax treatment affects their competitiveness against traditional lenders.
original_headline: Afico pide homologación fiscal para crowdfunding; advierte desincentivos al crédito
